evidence.note: Failure writers always set success false with an error string; the success writer sets success true and omits error.
logGenerationResults splits on success then reads error only on the failure arm, never handling success-with-error.

notes: Outcome ok | failed-with-error; output is an independent optional log blob on both arms.

evidence.note: hasFace is O.isSome(primaryFace); primaryFace and primaryFaceAreaPct are spread only on the Some arm, so hasFace-true with primaryFace absent is unrepresentable.

notes: Face outcome none | some(primary); flags also encode has-face vs no-face on the same entry.

evidence.note: hasBorder is borderCount > 0; classifyBorderSides returns none iff matched count is 0, so hasBorder duplicates classification!==none.
classifyBorderSides returns none then exclusive layout kinds; combined hasBorder-false with a non-none classification is never produced.

notes: None vs some-border; some-border still carries the layout kind payload.

evidence.note: validateWorkerReference Bool.matches accepted; accepted-true rejects a defined reason and accepted-false rejects a missing reason.
Accepted references must omit reason and carry detectionScore; rejected references must carry reason.
timedOut forces status partial; the failure arm writes status failed with timedOut false, so timedOut duplicates status===partial.
onFailure emptyPackageReport writes timedOut false with status failed; timedOut-true with completed or failed is not written.

notes: timedOut locksteps with partial; completed|failed share timedOut-false.

evidence.note: Budget-exceeded return writes timedOut true, status partial, and an error; the completed return writes timedOut false, status completed, error null.

notes: Collection outcome completed | partial-timeout; failed never appears on this result type.

evidence.note: keepPod true returns immediately with both statuses skipped-debug-keep and error null; keepPod false never writes skipped-debug-keep.
cleanupSkipped locksteps keepPod with skipped vs failed statuses.

notes: Cleanup mode kept | ran; ran still carries independent stop/delete outcomes.

evidence.note: mustMeet is score > match+tol and couldMeet is score >= match-tol; mustMeet implies couldMeet, so mustMeet && !couldMeet is unrepresentable.

notes: Leftover beside seeded hasQualityFlags/hasPartialAlignerRejection. Score vs match threshold below|in-band|above.

evidence.note: couldMeet is score >= review-tol and couldMiss is score <= review+tol; both-false requires score < review-tol and score > review+tol, which is unrepresentable.

notes: Leftover beside seeded quality/aligner flags. Score vs review threshold below|in-band|above.

evidence.note: exampleOnlyVoidsResult requires the void-discard pattern AND !OBSERVABLE_EXAMPLE_RESULT_PATTERN, so onlyVoids-true with observable-true is unrepresentable.

notes: Leftover beside seeded exampleOnlyVoidsResult/exampleDiscardsResult. Example result none|observable|void-only.

evidence.note: Missing metadata.orientation writes orientationApplied false and omits orientation; present orientation is always stored, with orientationApplied true only when !== 1. Applied-true with orientation absent is unrepresentable.

notes: Leftover beside seeded hasExif/hasIcc/hasIptc/hasXmp/orientationApplied. Orientation none | identity | applied.

evidence.note: exists false forces files to empty; nonempty files therefore imply exists. Empty-dir exists-true remains legal.
isFail is review.tier===fail with getOrElse false; isFail-true with review none or a non-fail tier is unrepresentable.

notes: Candidate fail-review | other; other still allows review none or non-fail.

evidence.note: matched is acceptedWidth >= minWidthPx; unmatched zeros widthPx, score, and widthPct, so matched duplicates nonzero measured width.
Backfill copies grandfathered and optionally grandfatheredNote together; the only census true row carries a note.
Adopt and Bootstrap write grandfathered false and omit grandfatheredNote; no in-lane producer writes true without the note.

notes: Leftover beside seeded requiresPullRequest/requiresMergeable/grandfathered. Gate ordinary | grandfathered-with-note.

evidence.note: GOAL_MANIFEST_BACKFILLS writes four false rows without grandfatheredNote and one true row with grandfatheredNote; both-true-without-note and false-with-note are not in the supported census.

notes: Census source for the persisted GoalCompletionGate leftover pair.

evidence.note: parkedPlan sets parked and omits isBackfill; planBackfill sets isBackfill true and omits parked; the mechanical editor omits both. Combined-true is not a producer.
No-stream planner writes streamPresent false with disposition streamless; sealedPlan always writes streamPresent true with skipped or append, so streamPresent duplicates disposition!==streamless.

notes: Leftover after seeded streamPresent/traceWritten split onto PacketTransitionOutcome.traceWritten. Streamless | present(skipped|append).
